s2.p1: No Rwandan federation appears among **WDSF** members. Partner dancing lives in **salsa**: in 2014, Jimmy Rudahunga ran free weekly classes in Kigali bars.
s2.p2: In 2021, after breaking got its Olympic green light, Rwandan breakers pitched their own federation to the **Ministry of Sports**.

s3.p: from across Africa for **FESPAD** 2013, the Pan African Dance Festival. It toured Rwanda, with workshops in salsa, hip hop and Kinyarwanda dance.

s4.p1: Rwandan-born **Sherrie Silver** choreographed Childish Gambino’s video, mixing dance styles from Ghana, Rwanda and Nigeria.
s4.p2: It won ==Best Choreography== at the 2018 MTV VMAs, and Silver collected the awards on his behalf.

s5.name: INTORE
s5.p: Dancers line up like **ranks of warriors**, leaping with spears and shields against an invisible enemy, to drums and horns. Also called the Dance of Heroes.

s5.name: UMUSHAGIRIRO
s5.p: A slow, elegant dance with **sliding steps**, usually performed by women. It honours the elegance of the cow, important in Rwandan culture.

s6.p: At the King’s Palace Museum, keepers sing poetry and play the flute to royal **Inyambo** cattle. In women’s dances, raised arms spread out to copy their horns.

s7.p: Inscribed in **Asunción**, Paraguay, Intore became Rwanda’s ==first== element on UNESCO’s intangible heritage list.
s7.p2: New national contest **Byina Rwanda** (Kigali, Aug 2026) listed **ballroom**, salsa and kizomba in its urban category. Top prize: Rwf5 million.
